text: 27-year-old male. The patient reports a sustained sensation of the room spinning since this morning, which is low grade and constant. speaker: Doctor
text: Since you have denied hearing symptoms and the vertigo is constant rather than positional, I suspect viral labyrinthitis or vestibular neuritis following your recent cold. Let me perform a physical exam to check for nystagmus and gait instability, and I will also request an audiogram to rule out any subtle hearing loss associated with Meniere's disease.
